asr.full_text: MIRROR Trading international MADEEASY You may be thinking about joining MTI or you may be a member already either way here are some of the main points MIRROR Trading International is a legally registered company in South Africa The objective of MIRROR Trading International is to GROW your Bitcoin This is done by trading on the Forex markets using Bitcoin as the base currency using advanced proprietary software that MTI has exclusively obtained the results speak for themselves and over the last 100 days of trading the daily profit for the investor has been 0.5834% please remember that historical data is not an indication of future results. You can add to your investment by depositing at any time, likewise you can withdraw at any time. With a company like Mirror Trading International, people often wonder where the greatest benefit is. The answer is simple. The greatest benefit you can get from MtiTI is by becoming a member or investor. You'll receive daily trading results from trades which take place from Monday to Friday. Compounding is automatic. This means your daily profit is added to your trading pool, and it becomes your new balance in trade. Sit back, relax, and watch your Bitcoin grow. As the price of Bitcoin goes up, so will your investment increase in value. Remember with historical results like these, your Bitcoin is growing. This is why we call MTI the investors game changer. Join Mirror Trading International today and experience all the benefits for yourself. The optional MTI Affiliate Programme This is open to all members who have an investment in Miratrading International. The idea behind the Affiliate Program is to provide additional bonuses over and above your investment. You receive 10% referral bonuses on all new investments made by the people you introduced to MTI. Binary profit-sharing bonuses. 20% of the daily profits are shared between all qualified members in accordance the size of their smallest team leg. To qualify for the weekly binary profit-sharing bonuses you will need to have introduced at least two investors to the MTI business. One in your left leg and one in your right leg. In addition to this, you will need to have introduced at least two investors to the MTI business one in your left leg and one in your right leg in addition to this, you will need to have a personal investment of at least $200 the Affiliate program has been designed to help you earn additional weekly residual income but may require you to do a bit of extra work please remember the affiliate program is optional and it is no way linked to the earning of your daily bonuses as an investor. For more information please contact the person who sent you this video

textual.context: Promotional/investment context; the description also provides a route to get started, but the supplied records do not show what the linked destination contains.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated daily-profit and Bitcoin-growth benefit is tied to joining or investing and adding funds by deposit, creating a reward-to-payment/action relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the company status, trading activity, profitability, withdrawals, or linked destination are accurate; no OCR or visual evidence is supplied.

textual.observation: An optional affiliate program offers referral and profit-sharing bonuses in connection with introducing new investors and maintaining a personal investment.

20% of the daily profits are shared between all qualified members

textual.context: The source presents the affiliate program as an optional earning opportunity and directs viewers to contact the person who sent the video.
textual.potential_relevance: Promised bonuses are directly linked to recruiting at least two investors and maintaining a $200 personal investment, making the recruitment-and-payment relationship relevant for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether bonuses were paid, whether the program operated as described, or whether participants experienced gains or losses.

visual.observation: The presentation states an objective to grow the viewer's Bitcoin, reports a 0.5834% daily average over 100 days, and says profits are automatically added to the balance for further trading. It also describes the benefit as becoming a member/investor.
visual.context: Promotional presentation for Mirror Trading International; the source frames do not establish whether the claims are independently verified.
visual.potential_relevance: A stated Bitcoin-growth and daily-return claim is linked to becoming a member/investor and having profits reinvested, which conditionally merits review of the promised financial outcome and investment process.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show a payment interface, recipient wallet, transaction, account outcome, or whether the stated historical performance continued.

visual.observation: The presentation says 20% of daily profits are shared among qualified members and states that qualification requires introducing at least two investors, one in each team leg, plus a personal investment of $200.
visual.context: The requirements are presented as conditions for a stated weekly Binary Profit Sharing bonus.
visual.potential_relevance: A profit-sharing benefit is explicitly tied to recruiting two investors and making a $200 personal investment, which conditionally merits review of the relationship between recruitment, payment, and the promised bonus.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether anyone paid, recruited others, received the bonus, or experienced a loss.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes joining as a member or investor to grow Bitcoin, cites a historical daily return of 0.5834%, describes depositing additional funds, and urges viewers to join. It also presents an affiliate opportunity in which referral and binary profit-sharing bonuses depend on introducing investors and maintaining a personal investment of at least $200. The historical-results disclaimer qualifies the return figure, and the available video evidence does not establish whether the advertised trading, withdrawals, bonuses, or linked destination produced the stated outcomes.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central offer asks viewers to become an MTI member or investor and presents Bitcoin growth through trading, recurring daily profit, and automatic compounding. This is best classified as participation in a managed investment linked to passive or compounding returns. The affiliate recruitment structure is secondary because it is presented as optional alongside the investment offer.
